problem_type: UI labels and durable protocol/prompt/default source values are conflated at workflow display boundaries
symptom: The integrated base reports 275 src hard-zero occurrences across 47 files, while preserved Scene3D UI references also lack their deleted locale namespace.
direct_cause: Visible workflow labels bypassed existing locale owners; several labels also served persisted/default/protocol/prompt consumers. The V1 Scene3D locale was deleted upstream but current integration retained its consumers.
class_root: Source/display conflation across workflow producers and readers: translating producer values would rewrite authored/prompt/protocol bytes, while leaving UI callers raw is not bilingual. Preserve one canonical formatter/default owner and translate only at actual UI readers.
affected_population: All 275 original hard-zero occurrences in 47 classified files; no unclassified source candidate remains.
Four persisted camera/Scene3D/Director defaults, historical Scene3D capture/title/prompt defaults, prop/capture metadata and original model instructions.
382 initial unresolved key-reference findings (369 Scene3D occurrences, 11 other missing-key occurrences and two other unregistered dynamic prefixes), resolved without a new prefix exception.
Existing Electron debt remains exactly 77 occurrences in 27 files; model-display and vendor-name classifications remain zero.
internal_only_reason: Repository DTOs, consumers and Blender harness determine source bytes and geometry; no external service behavior is changed.
invariants: Current-language text only changes presentation; user values and canonical saved/protocol/prompt defaults remain byte-stable.
No schema, scopes, approvals, retries, timezones, geometry or generation behavior changes.
No new exclusion, baseline, frozen count, vocabulary or self-written registry changes.
Unknown user text remains untouched at display adapters.

door_reduction.why_not: Measured with the unchanged AST door-map over the same named domain/display symbols, plus locale-owner reads within changed production consumers. New real display and canonical-source readers increase the count; existing public producers/readers must remain for compatibility. Inline camera-output, rationale and duplicate camera-directive implementations were actually removed; no fabricated door reduction.

generality_proof: UI readers use existing i18next/desktopT; saved defaults and source instructions use shared locale-neutral formatters. Display patterns are constructed from those actual source formatters, not copied locale text. Typed whole translation keys remain statically visible. Regression covers actual camera editor/result/title markup, source serialization, all 16 prop geometries and grid9 metadata, original prompt hashes, protocol admission and historical frame-slot matching in both locales.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Display only documented canonical source formats, preserve unknown/custom strings, never write back translated text.
Existing recipe display dictionary, typed full keys rather than unchecked dynamic prefix.
Register customWorkflow and restored historical Scene3D locale; no alternate translation engine.
One typed source/default owner reused by persisted producers and actual display adapters; all camera/prop/capture defaults remain locale-neutral.
Stable validation/progress/denial/action messages, independent of locale and approval behavior.
Canonical generation instructions/reference roles; preserve original Chinese prompt bytes.
Extend the existing desktopT resource owner only; no new main-process locale routing.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Count 0..9, original angles/defaults, reuse of edited records, actual editor/result SSR, no render-triggered write.
Baseline-derived hash of all 16 geometries/colors/source names in both locales.
Canonical refusal/progress bytes and unchanged reject/read-before-edit behavior; translate display copy only.
Historical Chinese title/prompt source remains canonical after restoring resources; original frame-slot matching works in both locales. Capture actions/fps/dimensions unchanged.
48 actual prompt hash checks across 12 recipe IDs, two identity policies and both locales, characterized from requested base; no real generation.

recurrence.reason: UI labels, cached/default names, protocol messages and instructions can repeatedly share raw strings without sharing display/storage responsibilities.
same_class_scan: Official read-only full inventory: 275 hard-zero occurrences in 47 files, all classified in the independent design card.
Initial two functional bilingual tests failed on pose display and source-node readiness before production edits.
Final official read-only report: src 0, model labels 0, vendor unclassified/stale 0, unchanged Electron 77/27.
Original fragile scanner reused read-only against base/current: all affected counts unchanged, zero new fragile matches.
Real AST door-map: 114 before, 181 after; pure-definition gaps explicitly reported rather than fabricated.

prevention.invariant: Localization does not rewrite canonical workflow/source data.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown user strings pass through; missing translations and untranslated UI still fail the existing hard-zero/key gates.
prevention.strategy: Reuse existing translation/display boundaries and centralize actual source constructors shared by writers/readers; do not change scanners, exclusions, baselines, thresholds or frozen model owners.

legacy_paths.rationale: Superseded private makeCameraOutputs/modeRationale and duplicated cameraMoveDirective implementations removed from these retained public modules. Reuse shared constructors/existing Director directive; no parallel implementation or deleted public feature.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse installed i18next, desktopT and TypeScript AST scanner; no dependency/runtime changes.

migration: No project or protocol migration; preserve canonical source bytes, existing names/IDs and all current defaults. Display follows current locale.
residual_risks: Full pnpm check:i18n command was not executed after auto-review rejected its automatic Electron-baseline writeback. Use official --report and the other read-only subchecks; do not bypass rejection.

Fragile-match remains red at the requested base's 13 over-baseline occurrences in six files. No new occurrence; machine-code/legacy compatibility/prompt-idempotency work is separate from visible-text translation.

Expanded 29-file regression: 289 pass / 2 fail. One is an existing legacy recipe-summary display gap (base module independently returns raw list_capability_recipes), the other an AI/manual node-kind migration-contract mismatch (unchanged AI dispatcher creates director; old test expects scene3d). These are reported, not declared obsolete or hidden by changing assertions. No canonical behavior rollback.
Five pure static-definition/formatter files have no local AST call/read doors. V3 keeps full scope and explicitly reports their checker warnings; no fake doors or generated markers.
Scoped lint leaves original warnings; coordinator's onboardingProviders/toolCallSummary unused-import removals are not duplicated.
No App launch, screenshot/video rendering or real generation; pixel/layout/platform/paid journeys and full CI remain for coordinator.
Preflight failed once on unchanged localhost proxy; remote freshness unverified. No account/proxy/memory/push/merge/frozen snapshot or count changes.
